# go-modern-sync-once-func

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use sync.OnceFunc instead of sync.Once plus a wrapper closure.

## Details

sync.OnceFunc wraps a function so that the returned function runs it at most once.
It is a compact fit for idempotent cleanup or one-time initialization hooks.

## Examples

### Before

```go
var once sync.Once
cleanup := func() {
  once.Do(func() {
    close(ch)
  })
}
```

### After

```go
cleanup := sync.OnceFunc(func() {
  close(ch)
})
```
